output.headline: Dental strategics and financial sponsors form the buyer universe for this Southeast practice; upper-quartile pricing is defensible, though mainly strategics can pay it.
sentences: Call Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental first: both are High conviction, have deals in the target's own sub-sector, and closed $409M and $392M deals, so size is no obstacle. [E:tier1]

Defensible pricing is the 75th percentile, 15.4x EBITDA against a 13.7x median, given the 18.0% margin; sponsors top out at $68M for a 20% return, so strategics must carry it. [E:valuation, E:lbo, E:tier1]

The review removed and merged no one; Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners stay in Tier 2 as technology investors, so confirm their appetite for tech-enabled services before outreach. [E:review, E:tier2]
Most buyers share one motive, geographic expansion, seen in 90% of 284 provider deals, so lead the pitch with the Southeast footprint. [E:motives]
